meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 CDP 启动/连接一个调试用 Chrome，复用你已有的登录状态，然后打开网页、读取页面文字、执行 JavaScript、提取登录令牌，还能模拟点击和输入。为避免误伤，它动手前会先检查，需要关掉你正开着的 Chrome 时会先征求你同意。
howto.when: 当需要控制 Chrome 通过 CDP 做自动化、复用已有登录会话，或提到“浏览器自动化”“CDP”“复用登录态”等触发词时。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 example.com，等页面加载后读出文字
say.note: 会先查 Chrome 状态，再开页面并读取内容。

say.text: 从 Chrome 里提取登录 token
用 CDP 在页面上点击“登录”按钮并输入账号
say.note: 会先生成页面快照，再定位按钮点击。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can control a CDP-enabled Chrome reusing your logged-in session: open URLs, read page text, extract tokens, click and type. It checks first and asks consent before killing your running Chrome.
howto.when_en: When you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP to reuse an existing login session, or mention trigger phrases like 'browser automation', 'CDP', or 'reuse login state'.

say_en.text: Use CDP to open example.com, wait for it to load, and read out the text.
say_en.note: Checks Chrome first, then opens page and reads it.

say_en.text: Extract the auth token from the current Chrome login state.
say_en.note: Runs JS to read localStorage or cookies.

say_en.text: Use CDP to click the 'login' button on the page and type the account.
say_en.note: Takes a snapshot, then locates the button and clicks it.
